    • ERROR

      public static final int ERROR
      ERROR msg, 9 - 12. Will show up on RC gui as red. Used when component needs a reset to fix.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • CODA_WARN

      public static final int CODA_WARN
      CODA_WARNING msg, 9. Will show up on RC gui as orange. Technically it's an error, but used as a warning when component state does not need to be changed, but error condition exists.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values

    • SEVERE

      public static final int SEVERE
      SEVERE msg, 13 - 14. Will show up as severe error on RC gui. To be used to indicate error needed the component to be killed and restarted.
      See Also:
      • Constant Field Values
